answers.core: Currently I haven't found a way to enable these hints from GDScript.
answers.workaround:
It's possible to workaround the issue by setting `SDL_JOYSTICK_HIDAPI_COMBINE_JOY_CONS` environment variable before launching the editor/game. I tried to set the environment variable in Godot by using `OS.set_environment`, but it didn't work.
We can probably change the code of `OS.set_environment` to also set SDL hints if that's acceptable though.

title: Allow JoyCon controllers to not be combined into one device on desktop platforms
